description: This file defines the 'ADODB_fbsql' class, which implements a database driver for the FrontBase SQL database within the ADODB database abstraction library. It includes methods for connecting, disconnecting, executing queries, fetching metadata, and handling record sets specific to the FrontBase SQL implementation.

classes.name: ADODB_fbsql
classes.description: Database driver class for FrontBase SQL in the ADODB library, providing connection management, query execution, and metadata retrieval.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_fbsql
classes.description: Recordset class for handling query results from a FrontBase SQL database within the ADODB framework.

methods.name: _insertid
methods.description: Returns the last inserted ID using fbsql_insert_id.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of affected rows by the last operation.

methods.name: MetaDatabases
methods.description: Retrieves the list of databases available on the server.

methods.name: Concat
methods.description: Generates a SQL CONCAT expression combining given arguments.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database server.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to the database server.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about the columns of a specified table.

methods.name: SelectDB
methods.description: Selects a database to use for subsequent queries.
